Name: Jodi's Less Ugly House
Author: 0Renciel
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=5][u][b][i]Jodi's Less Ugly House[/i][/b]

[/u][/size][size=3]A very simple mod with a fairly short description.[/size]

[size=3]Ever wondered why Sam gets the biggest bedroom in their house when his parents literally has a room that's the size of a closet? Same, clearly my girl Jodi deserves better to take her mind off the marriage she's in.[/size]

[u][size=4][b][s]I moved Jodi's and Vincent's door.[/s][/b][/size]
[/u][size=3]
[/size][size=5][b][color=#ea9999][i][u]NEW!! 1.0.4[/u][/i][/color][/b]
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]I moved the doors back lol[/size]
[*][size=3]Slight redesign, now more recolor and custom-cutscenes friendly[/size]
[*][size=3]Added a new dependency, now needs EML or EML for Android if you're on mobile![/size]
[/list]

[size=3]This has the most simplest coding that is known to man, so though I dread it I know there will be bugs and whatnot that I have overlooked. If you've spotted one, feel free to send a bug report [/size][u][b]AFTER[/b][/u][size=3] reading below. Bug reports from those who has clearly not read the mod description will be ignored and/or deleted!
[/size][size=1][b](Also, I know there's a couch that looks out of place by the entrance. That is the vanilla couch. I contemplated on changing it out but I decided I wanted to keep some of the Vanilla feel in the edit. The said vanilla feel is the HORRIBLE color matching that is a seemingly recurring theme throughout the Vanilla house. TLDR; I kept it to spite >:D)[/b][/size]

[size=4][i]Enjoy![/i][/size][color=#ff0000][size=5][b][i]

Very Important, Read me![/i][/b][/size][/color]

[size=5]What this mod [/size][color=#ff0000][b][i][u][size=5]DOESN'T[/size][/u] [/i][/b][/color][size=5]do:[/size]
[s]
[size=4][b]1. Add a night time version[/b][/size][/s][size=3]
[/size] 
[size=3]Learned how to do that, no more eternal sunlight :(([/size]

[size=4][s][b]2. Edits the Heart events[/b]
[/s][/size][size=3][s]
I made this mod with the VANILLA heart events in mind. So in theory, it should work fine [b]without[/b] any mods that expands on the households story, changes it's interiors, or adds any cutscenes inside their home.

[b]Now, in relation to that I am not sure how well this mod works with a big expansion.

[/b][/s][u][b]Version 1.0.4 should be good![/b][/u]

[/size][size=4][b]3. Fixes Jodi's marriage[/b][/size]

[size=3]No, sorry. Marry me instead Jodi.[/size]


[size=5][u][b][i]Compatibilities[/i][/b][/u][/size]

[u][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]East Scarp[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], if it adds a cutscene inside their home, you might experience some clipping issues. Otherwise should be okay![/size]
[u][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]RidgeSide Village[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], [/size][size=4]read above :)[/size]
[u][color=#ff0000][size=4][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], no.[/size][size=4]
[b][color=#00ff00][u]Household [/u][u]Expansions[/u][/color][/b], it most likely is.

[b]Regarding Sam Expansions[/b][size=3], as of version 1.0.4, worry not anymore![/size]
[b]Regarding SVE[/b], [/size][size=3]if it edits the interior of their house, then that'll be a no.[/size]

[u][size=5][b][i]Installation[/i][/b]

[/size][/u][size=3]1. Install Content Patcher and Extra Map Layers (EML for Android if you're on mobile!)
2. Download this mod
3. Extract the zip into your mods folder 
4. Viola![/size][/font]
